effect: Can calm entry-to-drive-off balance by adding diagonal support.
counter_effect: May bind the center or add scrub if the car was already loaded too tightly.
test_language: Run comparable laps and validate exit yaw, center speed, and tire trend.
small_swing_hint: Use a small diagonal change only.
cautions: Treat as a strong balance lever.

effect: Can free center rotation and reduce bound-up drive-off feel.
counter_effect: May make throttle pickup nervous or reduce rear security.
test_language: Run comparable laps and validate center speed, exit yaw, and correction count.
small_swing_hint: Use a small cross change and keep the rest of the package still.
cautions: Avoid stacking with another major balance change.

effect: Can add front platform support when contact or front feed instability appears.
counter_effect: May take front grip away in the center if support becomes too stiff.
test_language: Compare front contact, center speed, and steering trace in the same track zone.
small_swing_hint: Use a small spring step only after platform evidence points there.
cautions: Spring rate is a package-level lever.

effect: Can give the front tire more compliance and help the car point.
counter_effect: May increase platform contact or front feed instability if travel margin is weak.
test_language: Validate turn-in response with front height and contact evidence.
small_swing_hint: Use a small step and watch platform margin.
cautions: Do not infer aero gain from this alone.

effect: Can add a little rear support and clean up throttle-on balance.
counter_effect: May change tire heat trend or tighten late exit.
test_language: Compare exit yaw, throttle pickup, and tire trend over similar laps.

effect: Can add a little front compliance and help the car accept steering.
counter_effect: May overwork the tire or reduce stability if taken too far.
test_language: Validate with steering trace, center speed, and tire trend.
small_swing_hint: Treat as a fine-tuning pressure move.

direction: Tune rear pressure split for stability
effect: Can calm rear support during throttle pickup when tire evidence agrees.
counter_effect: May hurt long-run temperature balance or make exit too flat.
test_language: Check comparable exit traces and rear tire trend before keeping the change.
small_swing_hint: Use a small rear pressure split change.
cautions: Do not use as a substitute for missing platform evidence.

effect: Can add front roll compliance and help the nose work in the corner.
counter_effect: May reduce front platform support or make entry less secure.
test_language: Compare steering demand, center speed, and front platform stability.
cautions: ARB arm is coupled to the full roll package.

effect: Can add front roll support and reduce entry wash from platform motion.
counter_effect: May make center tighter or increase front tire load.
test_language: Validate entry stability without losing center speed.

direction: Switch front ARB to soft bar
effect: Can make a large front roll compliance change.
counter_effect: May change the whole platform balance and reduce support.
test_language: Treat as a package test and compare center speed plus platform traces.
small_swing_hint: Use only when a bar-package test is intended.
cautions: Next Gen soft diameter is 1.375 in.

direction: Switch front ARB to stiff bar
effect: Can make a large front support change.
counter_effect: May bind the center or increase front tire load.
test_language: Compare front platform support, center speed, and tire trend.
small_swing_hint: Use only as a package test.
cautions: Next Gen stiff diameter is 2.000 in.

effect: Can reduce rear roll stiffness leverage and calm throttle-on oversteer.
counter_effect: May take rotation away or make the car lazy off.
test_language: Validate exit yaw, throttle trace, and center rotation.

effect: Can add rear roll leverage and help the car rotate.
counter_effect: May make throttle pickup nervous.
test_language: Compare center rotation against exit yaw and correction count.

effect: Can calm rear rotation while braking into entry.
counter_effect: May make the car push on entry or overload the front tires.
test_language: Validate brake trace, entry yaw, and front tire trend.

effect: Can help the car rotate while braking if entry is too front-limited.
counter_effect: May make the rear unstable under brake.
test_language: Compare entry yaw and brake stability in the same braking zone.

effect: Can reduce front contact and stabilize front feed behavior.
counter_effect: May reduce front bite or alter center balance.
test_language: Validate front contact, front height, and speed trace together.
small_swing_hint: Use the smallest platform support change that can be measured.
cautions: Do not describe diffuser proxy as measured downforce.

effect: Can improve front bite when the platform has margin.
counter_effect: May increase contact or destabilize front feed if margin is already thin.
test_language: Validate front height and contact before judging balance.

effect: Can calm rear platform motion and improve throttle-on security.
counter_effect: May change outlet behavior or add drag-like speed loss if the platform moves out of its window.
test_language: Validate exit yaw with rear height, scrape, diffuser proxy, and speed trace.
small_swing_hint: Use a small rear platform support step.
cautions: Rear height alone does not describe rear aero behavior.

effect: Can free exit and improve speed when rear platform evidence shows excess support.
counter_effect: May reduce rear security or create scrape/choke behavior.
test_language: Compare exit rotation, rear scrape, and straight speed.

effect: Can slow front compression during driver-input body motion.
counter_effect: May make the front feel rigid or delay grip acceptance.
test_language: Validate selected-zone shock velocity, steering, and entry yaw.
small_swing_hint: Use a small click-style change if available.
cautions: Whole-lap shock histogram should not overrule selected-zone evidence.

effect: Can let the front accept driver-input body motion more freely.
counter_effect: May create front platform movement if support was already marginal.
test_language: Compare turn-in response with selected-zone shock and front platform evidence.

effect: Can slow front extension and calm weight transfer during throttle pickup.
counter_effect: May hold the front down too long and hurt drive or exit speed.
test_language: Validate exit yaw, throttle pickup, and selected-zone rebound evidence.

effect: Can release the front sooner during throttle pickup.
counter_effect: May make the rear feel less secure if transfer becomes abrupt.
test_language: Compare drive-off speed, exit yaw, and selected-zone shock evidence.

effect: Can slow rear extension and calm throttle-on transition.
counter_effect: May over-control rear platform or reduce drive.
test_language: Validate exit yaw, throttle trace, and selected-zone rear rebound evidence.
cautions: Confirm the phase before treating shocks as the answer.

effect: Can let the rear recover more freely during throttle pickup.
counter_effect: May make rear motion too quick if the car is already loose off.
test_language: Validate drive-off speed and exit yaw with rear shock evidence.

effect: Can add support over bumps or impact events.
counter_effect: May make the car harsh or keep the platform from absorbing track texture.
test_language: Validate bump-zone shock velocity, contact, and speed trace.
small_swing_hint: Use only after bump-zone evidence points there.

effect: Can let the car absorb bumps with less impact harshness.
counter_effect: May reduce platform support over large impacts.
test_language: Compare bump-zone shock velocity, contact events, and driver corrections.

effect: Can slow platform recovery after bumps.
counter_effect: May keep the platform tied down too long over repeated bumps.
test_language: Validate platform recovery in selected bump zones.

effect: Can let the platform recover more quickly after impacts.
counter_effect: May let motion return too fast if platform stability was the issue.
test_language: Validate selected-zone recovery and correction count.

effect: Can add rear directional stability.
counter_effect: May add scrub and reduce straight speed.
test_language: Validate correction count, exit yaw, and straight speed.

effect: Can reduce alignment scrub when speed trace and setup evidence agree.
counter_effect: May reduce stability or response depending which axle changes.
test_language: Validate straight speed, steering correction, and phase balance.
cautions: Do not trade away stability without exit evidence.

effect: Can make throttle pickup more connected and reduce one-wheel-feel complaints.
counter_effect: May bind center or make the car push off.
test_language: Validate throttle pickup, exit yaw, and center rotation.

effect: Can reduce driveline bind and help rotation.
counter_effect: May hurt connected drive off if traction was already marginal.
test_language: Compare center rotation, throttle pickup, and exit yaw.

effect: Can improve acceleration if RPM placement is too low.
counter_effect: May cost terminal speed or hit the limiter.
test_language: Validate RPM trace, exit acceleration, and end-of-straight speed.
small_swing_hint: Use only when gearing evidence is clear.
cautions: This is a broad speed tradeoff.

effect: Can improve terminal speed when RPM is too high or limiter margin is thin.
counter_effect: May soften drive off and hurt acceleration.
test_language: Validate RPM trace, exit acceleration, and end-of-straight speed.
small_swing_hint: Use only when gearing evidence is clear.

effect: Can add legacy rear rotation tendency when the car supports this adjustment.
counter_effect: May make rear security worse or over-free exit.
test_language: Validate center rotation and exit yaw on a supported legacy car.
small_swing_hint: Use a small supported garage step.

effect: Can calm legacy rear rotation when the car supports this adjustment.
counter_effect: May reduce rotation and bind the center.
test_language: Validate rear stability and center speed on a supported legacy car.
small_swing_hint: Use a small supported garage step.

effect: Can change legacy rear geometry behavior during drive-off.
counter_effect: May create a new rear-steer feel or upset throttle transition.
test_language: Validate drive-off and yaw only on a supported legacy car.

direction: Tune bump stop or packer support
effect: Can change legacy platform support timing when the car supports these parts.
counter_effect: May create harsh contact timing or reduce compliance.
test_language: Validate travel, scrape, and selected-zone platform behavior on a supported legacy car.
